evidence_items.locator: Experiment 2, Results; Experimental Design and Experiment 1, Methods and Results
evidence_items.explanation: Tests conducted from March through November used unselected generations and found human-rated matches of 45% for physical relations and 12.3% for unmodified negation prompts. Ordinary prompt rewriting improved negation matching to 40.7%, leaving substantial failures even with that assistance.

unresolved_gaps: The selected study does not establish error prevalence across all real-world requests or every contemporary generator.
The tests cover relations, negation, and counting more directly than anatomical parts and labels.
